description:
## Goal

Make ReturnType and ActivationInputs retain exactly the independently supported semantic alternatives. Cyclic copies are never new ground; removing the last real ground retracts only its exact transitive dependents.

## Identity and ordered disjunction

An alternative retains its exact correlated payload and aligned owner-qualified control evidence. For pattern dispatch, the minimal control fact is the typed dispatch-plan occurrence plus Outcome or Fail, instantiated by the exact correlated input and pin or guard operands.

One outcome means the current arm matched after all preceding arms missed. It represents every graph route to that terminal without retaining paths. OutcomeId, GuardId and SubjectId are plan-local and never stand alone. Display strings, spans, source order numbers and raw allocation IDs are never authority.

PatternDispatchPlan and OutcomeEdge remain the sole pattern and subject-to-value denotation. Do not add an AST pattern pass, DNF or BDD domain, proof graph, miss-path expansion or downstream reconstruction. Literal, pin, guard, map-presence and bitstring residuals survive even where Ty cannot express them.

## Support law

Use one World fact authority with two derived movement projections: semantic value and support or finality. Equal value reproduction preserves its allocation and wakes no value reader; a support-only movement wakes only formulas that consume support.

Source-owned alternatives are ground. Every semantic transfer is strictly positive. Alternative derivations choose the minimum finite derivation height; jointly required operands use one plus their maximum height. Rank alone is insufficient after withdrawal: a typed Shift dirties the exact existing DependencyIndex cone, and dirty or unfinal publishers cannot lend stale support. Clean independent publishers remain visible. No SCC solver, drain scan, retained operand proof circuit, private cone or repair pass is permitted.

This model depends on fz-kdt.177 supplying a proved finite recursive or parameterized denotation. No bound may assume that finite source sites imply finitely many concrete alternatives.

## Required laws

Prove self and mutual cycle withdrawal, independent equal grounds, removal of one forwarding edge, support-only versus value movement, explicit none versus absent evidence, and continuation reachability independent of unavailable return values. Contract refinement occurs per whole correlated row before return union; an empty intersection is a row diagnostic.

Later literal, pin, guard, map and bitstring arms retain their plan-qualified residual even when their Ty matches an earlier path. Nested outcomes conjoin parent evidence. Repeated call arguments preserve shared identity; calls and returns transport aligned alternatives without Cartesian blending.

The accepted eight and nine row cycle converges under FIFO, LIFO and permutations with identical alternatives and artifacts. Equal reproduction performs no downstream work.

## Deletion and acceptance

Replace conclude_preserving_frontier, grow-only ActivationInputs history, first-row return selection, stale typed-slot reuse, unsupported standing claims, key-derived resurrection and columnwise budget collapse. Delete temporary probes, compatibility stores and obsolete docs. Preserve or reduce deterministic evaluations, wakes, allocations and store work. Full focused, corpus, three-door, deterministic, documentation, formatting, check and strict-Clippy gates pass; fresh ticket-scoped cold review precedes one commit and close.

comments.text: RIDER (fz-kdt.106 landed, a010532e8, 2026-09-01): NOT dissolved, but the decision is easier now. Dominance absorption removed the ascent-history accumulation that made input narrowing look necessary (the predicate wide cone is gone; per-callsite maxima are what settle). The asymmetry itself stands: ActivationInputs still cannot narrow on rebase while ReturnType can, and fz-kdt.82's withdrawal-as-ascent hazard still gates enabling it. Also relevant: both replace-shaped semantics were REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE during 106 (non-settlement via the budget-cliff ping-pong through the caller-callee 2-cycle; see fz-kdt.106's record) -- any resolution of this ticket that adds a mid-drive narrowing path must answer that refutation.

title: Retain exactly the supported semantic alternatives
